gaps.sentence: Last night's ___ (PERFORM) ended with a standing ovation.
gaps.explanation: 'Last night's performance' — the noun for the event.

gaps.sentence: The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.
The company has made huge ___ (INVEST) in training.
The report was highly ___ (CRITIC) of the new scheme.
gaps.explanation: 'Highly critical of' — the adjective describing a judgement.

gaps.sentence: The factory has doubled its ___ (PRODUCE) of electric batteries.
gaps.explanation: 'Its production' — the noun for the amount manufactured follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: She showed great ___ (WISE) in avoiding the deal.
gaps.explanation: 'Wisdom' — the quality noun from wise (spelling: wise → wisdom).
